# NeuralFusion

> NeuralFusion is a cognitive operating system for how you think. It helps people understand their thinking patterns, recognize cognitive fragmentation, train greater integration across four thinking modes, and make clearer decisions, built on the Four Thinking Modes Framework and the CFI (Cognitive Fragmentation Index).

NeuralFusion was founded by Life Edet. It is not an AI chatbot, a productivity app, a therapy platform, or a general wellness app. Its focus is human cognitive agency: preserving and developing human judgment and thinking capacity, particularly in an AI-heavy environment.

## Core Concepts

- [Cognitive Fragmentation](https://tryneuralfusion.com/cognitive-fragmentation): what it is, causes, and how it affects decisions
- [Cognitive Performance](https://tryneuralfusion.com/cognitive-performance): mental clarity, focus, and reasoning under pressure
- [Thinking & the Four Thinking Modes Framework](https://tryneuralfusion.com/thinking): Analytical, Intuitive, Associative, Reflective
- [Decision-Making](https://tryneuralfusion.com/decision-making): structured decision-making under pressure
- [CFI Methodology](https://tryneuralfusion.com/methodology): what the CFI measures, does not measure, and its current limitations
- [Human Intelligence & AI](https://tryneuralfusion.com/human-intelligence-ai): human cognitive agency in the age of AI

## Pathways

- [For Organisations](https://tryneuralfusion.com/organisations): team assessment, training and decision practice for organisations
- [Academic Partnerships](https://tryneuralfusion.com/academic-partnerships): collaboration, pilots and methodology discussion. States clearly what is and is not validated
- [Executive Programme](https://tryneuralfusion.com/executive): individual assessment, Core Loop and Decision Room for founders and senior leaders
- [Contact](https://tryneuralfusion.com/contact): enquiry pathways

## Research

- [Research & Publications](https://tryneuralfusion.com/research): founder paper (SSRN 2026), CFI research status and academic collaboration. The paper is not described as peer-reviewed journal articles and the CFI is not independently validated
- [About / Founder](https://tryneuralfusion.com/about)
